verdict.rationale: Clerk documents configuration-driven sign-in with external identity providers. Enterprise SSO supports IdPs such as Azure AD, Okta and Google Workspace over SAML and OIDC, and the CLI claims to set up OAuth providers for production. The prebuilt SignIn components mean no custom auth code is needed. However, the evidence never lists a broad catalog of consumer social providers. Missing for 10: an explicit list of supported social OAuth providers (e.g. Google, GitHub, Apple), docs showing dashboard-only enablement of social connections, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
